intent: Join a run of an InputOtp's slots into one visually attached segment.
typical_uses: One run of slots, for instance each half of a six-digit code split by a separator

dont_use_when.situation: Joining buttons into one attached row
Joining a text input with its addons into one frame

invariants.text: The group is a plain div with no role and no state of its own; it takes part in neither the value nor the focus order, which stay with the root and its slots. Only its first and last slot get rounded outer corners, and adjacent slots share one border.

anti_patterns.dont: Give the group an accessible name or a role to describe the code
anti_patterns.do_instead: Label the InputOtp root instead - the primitive already renders it as the role="group" that assistive tech announces for the field

bad.title: A group with no InputOtp around it
bad.why: The group is only a div; its slots read their character and state from the InputOtp root through the primitive's context, and throw when that context is missing.
